key_patterns: Admin wire contract is reconciled to the AS-BUILT merged Go handlers (commit df547be), VERIFIED by reading the real structs: internal/httpapi/admin_handlers.go (createFlowRequest {env,flowId,method,path,tree,fixtures?,note?,version(ignored)}; setActiveRequest {env,version,reason?}; createJDMRequest {env,jdmId,doc,version?,note?}; createConnectionRequest {env,key,type,settings?,secretRef?,resilience?}), internal/httpapi/admin_validate.go (validateFlowRequest stored={env,flowId,version}; candidate={env,flow:{...}} — CMS uses STORED mode only), and internal/connect/connect.go (ResiliencePolicy is TAG-LESS: Timeout time.Duration serialized as a nanosecond integer under the Go field name `Timeout`, Retry.MaxAttempts). ALL request bodies are FLAT (env is a top-level sibling, NO flow/connection wrapper) and decoded with DisallowUnknownFields, so a wrapper or stray field is a hard 400. Status codes the CMS keys off: 422=publish-blocking un-validated version (config.ErrUnvalidated, NOT 409); 409=create-time route (method,path) collision (config.ErrRouteConflict); 400=bad shape/non-empty env/wrapper/inline secret; 404=stored-mode validate version-not-found; 403=under-privileged operator token; 401=bad/absent bearer. Publish ordering: listConnections -> createConnection(only changed) -> createJdm (create==activate) -> createFlow(validated=false) -> validateFlow(stored {env,flowId,version:N}) -> publishFlow. env sent in body = Environment.payloadEnv (default ""), NOT the Environment name; cross-env selection is by base URL + operator token. Connection settings are the discrete credential-free driver shape (host/port/database/user/sslmode + nested pool.{maxConns,minConns}) + secretRef, NEVER a dsn and NEVER a secret value; secret denylist (case-insensitive) = password,pwd,secret,token,apikey,dsn. Flow-canvas serializer MUST preserve MIXED casing: operation.{Kind,Payload,Required} capitalized (tag-less Go Operation struct), everything else camelCase (condition trueKey/falseKey, set targetPath/from, decision jdmId/input/saveAs, action connection/saveAs). Both editor custom fields register with base type:'json'. React stays on 18.3.1 (Strapi 5.56 peers react ^18); reactflow pinned 11.11.4 to match the version @gorules/jdm-editor@1.52.0 bundles so ONE React Flow runtime ships.
